author: Dragunovi
subject: 1.17.2 Final Itemization Changelog
content_md:
![itemization-changelog.jpg](./download/file.php?id=76) <dd>itemization-changelog.jpg (142.3 KiB) Viewed 115305 times</dd>
Greetings! We're happy to present the **final** itemization changelog detailing all item related additions and changes coming in **Patch 1.17.2: Tower of Karazhan.**

This patch has been a massive undertaking for everyone in the team involved, amassing over **1300(!)** new items for this patch alone, some with completely new effects such as the new relics and quite a few items from Upper Karazhan. This total number does not count the existing item changes, item set changes and item set additions such as the many new and unique set bonuses added with Alternative Tier Sets and Tier 3.5, a few off-set item sets from Upper Karazhan and a few item sets for Jewelcrafting.

Keep in mind all changes are subject to change and to not look at these changes in a vacuum, this is the massive class changes patch after all.

 **Summary:**
- Adjusted quite a few dungeon drops, especially changing Uncommon items in dungeons at or above level 40 to be Rare quality and buffed accordingly. We've also buffed the majority of Gilneas City boss drops to make the dungeon desirable outside of completing quests.

- We've turned the dial back slightly on most of the Moroes drops.

- Almost all of the Royal Seals of Eldre'thalas have been revamped to be useful for majority of specializations, exceptions being already good for all the specializations of that class.

- Quite a few old items were adjusted and a few new ones were added in accordance to the weapon skill formula rework.

- Moved the new items away from the original Ouro loot table and into a new one alongside with even more new items in it.

- Buffed most of the underperforming caster staves in tiers below Naxxramas more worthwhile to use, primarily buffing their spellpower to be near equal to one-handed weapon and off-hand frill/shield options.

- Buffed reputation rewards for Warsong Gulch and Arathi Basin, making the grind much more worthwhile.

- Buffed Atiesh for Priest to have spellpower equal to Warlock and Mage, and Atiesh for Druid to have more feral attack power, changed the aura granted to be useful for all roles and added spellpower similiar to the Priest version.

- Revamped or improved a few existing set bonuses, notably the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj Tier Set for Hunter and Zul'Gurub Tier Set for Warlock.

- Revamped itemization on a few original tier sets due to them no longer being split in power between multiple specializations thanks to the introduction of Alternative Tier Sets.
 **Tier Set Bonus Changes:**

Majority of these changes were made to integrate Survival Hunter and Deep Destruction Warlock abilities into existing tier sets, this was done instead of adding completely new tier sets due to these specializations requiring the same stats as the current sets provide. In addition to this we've polished and reworked a few underwhelming set bonuses to be much more useful and relevant.
As a specific note, the Hunter Tier 2 8 Set Bonus was converted to be a personal buff due this effect being way too powerful if it also included melee attack power and to make it a less mandatory effect as a raid debuff.

- Hunter Tier 0/0.5 (6/4 Set): Also triggers from melee attacks.

- Hunter Zul'Gurub Set (3 Set): Also reduces the cooldown of your Wing Clip.

- Hunter Zul'Gurub Set (5 Set): Now does the following: "Reduces the time between periodic ticks and duration of Serpent Sting by 20%."

- Hunter Tier 1 (8 Set): Also increases the damage of your Carve by 15%.

- Hunter Tier 2 (3 Set): Now also increases the melee attack power of your Aspect of the Wolf by 20%.

- Hunter Tier 2 (8 Set): Now does the following: "You have a chance whenever you deal melee or ranged damage to gain the Detect Weakness effect. Detect Weakness increases your Attack Power by 450 for 7 sec."

- Hunter Tier 2.5 (3 Set): Now does the following: "Your Serpent Sting damage has a 20% chance to deal 100 Nature damage and energize you for 40 Mana."

- Hunter Tier 3 (6 Set): Also triggers from melee attacks.

- Hunter Tier 3 (8 Set): Also reduces the mana cost of your Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Carve.

- Warlock Zul'Gurub Set (3 Set): Now does the following: "Corruption now deals an amount of damage equal to 1.5 sec. of Corruption upon application."

- Warlock Zul'Gurub Set (5 Set): Also reduces the cooldown of Soul Fire.

- Warlock Tier 1 (8 Set): Also reduces the mana cost of Fire spells.

- Warlock Tier 3 (2 Set): Now has a chance to trigger from Searing Pain with half the chance of Shadow Bolt.

- Warrior Tier 0/0.5 (6/4 Set): Also energizes you for 10 Rage when triggered.

- Mage Tier 2 (8 Set): Now correctly triggers on spell cast instead of spell hit.

- Shaman Tier 2.5 (5 Set): Reworked, now does the following: "Your Chain Lightning is imbued with unpredictable storm energies, it now chains to an additional target and deals 15% increased damage if it hits only one target."

- Shaman Tier 3 (8 Set): Now grants 15 MP5 while Water Shield is active instead of Lightning Shield.
We won't list all the changes here as the set bonuses have been shuffled around with the introduction of Alternative Tier Sets and explaining them would make this much more complicated, so I recommend checking them out in-game when the patch is released.

 **Tier Set Itemization Changes:**
- Converted Tier 2.5 Shaman Original Set into a full Elemental Set. Removed Agility and Strength from all pieces in accordance to this change.
 - Stormcaller's Diadem:Intellect and Stamina increased from 22 to 24, added 5 MP5.

 - Stormcaller's Pauldrons: Intellect increased from 13 to 16, Stamina increased from 15 to 16, increased MP5 from 4 to 6.

 - Stormcaller's Hauberk: Intellect and Stamina increased from 24 to 25, Spellpower increased from 32 to 41.

 - Stormcaller's Leggings:  Intellect and Stamina increased from 22 to 23, Spellpower increased from 29 to 34.

 - Stormcaller's Footguards: Spellpower increased from 22 to 29.

- Converted Tier 2.5 Priest Original Set into a full Discipline/Smite Priest set.
 - Tiara of the Oracle: Replaced 28 Spellpower with 33 Holy Spellpower, reduced MP5 from 7 to 6, added 1% Spell Crit.

 - Mantle of the Oracle: Reduced Intellect from 20 to 16, reduced Stamina from 21 to 17, increased Spirit from 8 to 10, replaced 20 Spellpower with 27 Holy Spellpower, replaced 10 Spell Penetration with 1% Spell Crit.

 - Raiments of the Oracle: Increased Stamina from 23 to 26, increased Spirit from 15 to 18, replaced 36 Spellpower with 39 Holy Spellpower, replaced 10 Spell Penetration with 1% Spell Hit.

 - Trousers of the Oracle: Now grants 1% Spell Hit, replaced 33 Spellpower with 34 Holy Spellpower.

 - Footwraps of the Oracle: Replaced 21 Spellpower with 27 Holy Spellpower.

- Converted Tier 2 Shaman Original Set into a full Elemental Set. Removed Spirit and Healing Power from all pieces in accordance to this change.
 - Helmet of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 20 to 22, Reduced Intellect from 24 to 23, Increased Spellpower from 14 to 33.

 - Epaulets of Ten Storms: Reduced Stamina from 23 to 14, Increased Intellect from 17 to 20, Added 23 Spellpower.

 - Breastplate of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 17 to 18, Reduced Intellect from 31 to 25, Added 1% Spell Hit, Increased Spellpower from 23 to 35.

 - Bracers of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 13 to 15, Increased Intellect from 16 to 18, Removed 6 MP5, Added 16 Spellpower.

 - Gauntlets of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 15 to 16, Increased Intellect from 17 to 18, Increased Spellpower from 12 to 13, Removed 6 MP5, Added 1% Spell Hit and Haste.

 - Belt of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 13 to 16, Increased Spellpower from 14 to 23.

 - Legplates of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 16 to 22, Increased Intellect from 18 to 23, Increased Spellpower from 29 to 30, Removed 1% Spell Crit, Added 1% Spell Hit.

 - Greaves of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 17 to 18, Reduced Intellect from 16 to 15, Increased Spellpower from 20 to 25, Added 1% Spell Hit.

- Converted Tier 1 Paladin Original Set into a full Holy Paladin set. Removed all Agility, Strength, Spirit and Spellpower in accordance to this change.
 - Lawbringer Chestguard: Increased Intellect from 204 to 21, Reduced Stamina from 26 to 20, Increased Healing Power from 24 to 35, Added 1% Spell Crit.

 - Lawbringer Boots: Reduced Stamina from 20 to 15, Increased Healing Power from 18 to 20, Added 1% Spell Crit.

 - Lawbringer Belt: Reduced Stamina from 15 to 11, Increased Intellect from 20 to 25.

 - Lawbringer Gauntlets: Increased Healing Power from 18 to 29.

 - Lawbringer Helm: Increased Intellect from 24 to 26, Increased Healing Power from 24 to 31.

 - Lawbringer Legplates: Reduced Stamina from 24 to 20, Increased MP5 from 3 to 5, Increased Healing Power from 24 to 42.

 - Lawbringer Spaulders: Increased Intellect from 15 to 18, Reduced Stamina from 22 to 15, Increased Healing Power from 18 to 31.

 - Lawbringer Bracers: Added 26 Healing Power.

- Converted Tier 2 Paladin Original Set into a full Holy Paladin set. Removed all Agility, Strength, Spirit and Spellpower in accordance to this change.
 - Judgement Belt: Increased Intellect from 20 to 22, Replaced 23 Spellpower with 40 Healing Power.

 - Judgement Bindings: Replaced 7 Spellpower with 15 Healing Power, Added 1% Haste.

 - Judgement Breastplate: Increased Stamina from 21 to 24, Increased Intellect from 21 to 25, Replaced 25 Spellpower with 48 Healing Power, Added 2% Haste, Added back 10 Fire Resistance.

 - Judgement Crown: Increased Stamina from 18 to 24, Increased Intellect frm 23 to 26, Replaced 32 Spellpower with 51 Healing Power, Added 1% Haste, Added back 10 Frost Resistance.

 - Judgement Gauntlets: Reduced Stamina from 15 to 12, Replaced 15 Spellpower with 37 Healing Power, Removed 6 MP5, Added 2% Haste.

 - Judgement Legplates: Reduced Stamina from 26 to 20, Reduced Intellect from 27 to 18, Replaced 20 Spellpower with 42 Healing Power, Increased MP5 from 4 to 5, Added back 10 Arcane Resistance.

 - Judgement Sabatons: Increased Stamina from 20 to 22, Replaced 18 Spellpower with 15 Healing Power, Added 6 MP5.

 - Judgement Spaulders: Increased Intellect from 14 to 15, Reduced Stamina from 20 to 18, Replaced 13 Spellpower with 31 Healing Power, Removed 5 MP5.

- Bloodfang Spaulders: Replaced 1% Dodge with Crit.

- Bloodfang Boots: Replaced 1% Dodge with Hit.
This list is not all-encompassing on changes to item sets as we've done adjustments to original tier sets before, please refer to previous patch changelogs and [Pre-1.17.0 Item Sets and Adjustments](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=52795) for more information on those.

 **Stat Adjustments**:
- Meditation's stat budget has seen a lookover. In simple terms: Some items should see a small nerf while some items should see an overall buff from this change. If a Meditation item is not listed in the stat specific changelog section below then the item is unchanged.

- Resillience is seeing a complete rework. Instead of reducing your chance to be critically struck, it will instead reduce the damage of critical strikes and damage over time effects on you, making it much more oriented for PvP combat, as it was mostly utilized by PvE tanks to get rid of critical strikes from bosses.

 **The conversion rate is:** 1% reduced chance to get critically struck is turned into 3% reduced damage from critical strikes and damage over time effects. To avoid any confusion, anything in the changelog that lists resillience as 3% is for the new version of the stat, equal to 1% of the old version.

Please keep in mind that this change will go live alongside other class centric changes such as the addition of the Alternative Tier Sets and the second batch of Class Changes, don't look at this in a vacuum.
 **Weapon Skill Additions to Existing Items (as per Class Changes 2 Revamp):**

As a foreword to these changes, please keep in mind that the weapon skill formula was adjusted to make each point of skill about half as good as it was in Vanilla while removing the hidden formula that granted +1% Hit upon reaching the soft cap, and that you can permanently gain +5 Skill for all weapon types by doing their specific questlines and all racial weapon skill gains were reduced from +5 to +3, please consider these changes with that in mind.
These changes should allow physical damage dealers to have more options in gaining weapon skill and not being pigeonholed into specific items for the rest of their character's progression such as Edgemaster's Handguards.

- Doom's Edge: Added +4 Skill to 1H Axes, reduced Agility from 16 to 12.

- Hedgecutter: Added +3 Skill to 1H Axes, reduced Stamina from 12 to 10.

- Anubisath Warhammer: Increased 1H Maces skill from +4 to +5, reduced Attack Power from 32 to 26.

- Spineshatter: Added +5 Skill to 1H Maces, reduced Stamina from 16 to 13, removed 5 Defense.

- Claymore of Unholy Might: Added +7 Skill to Two-Handed Swords, removed 15 Intellect.

- Drake Talon Cleaver: Added +8 Skill to 2H Axes, reduced Strength from 22 to 17.

- Tempest's Rage: Added +4 Skill to 1H Swords.

- Dragonfang Blade: Added +5 Skill to Daggers, reduced Agility from 16 to 13.

- Bile-Covered Gauntlets: Added +7 Skill to 1H and 2H Axes, removed 20 Nature Resistance.

- Blooddrenched Grips: Added +5 Skill to 1H Axes, reduced Stamina from 16 to 12.

- Flameguard Gauntlets: Added +7 Skill to 2H Axes, reduced Stamina from 13 to 6.

- Legplates of the Qiraji Command: Added +2 Skill to 1H and 2H Swords, reduced Strength from 20 to 16.

- Slime-coated Leggings: Added +5 Skill to Polearms, removed 11 Spellpower.

- Eye of Nerub: Added +5 Skill to Polearms, no longer grants +2 Skill to Bows, Guns and Crossbows.

- Added two new gauntlets to Ouro's new loottable which grant weapon skill to various weapon types, similiarly to Edgemaster's Handguards, read more on that below.
 **Ouro Loottable Changes**:
- Added a new loottable with 4 new items and 2 existing items that were originally added to the existing loottable.
 - New Items:

 - Wormscale Stompers and Wormhide Boots have been moved to the new loottable.

 - Gloves of the Primordial Burrower

 - Carapace Handguards

 - Wormhide Protector

 - Ivonor, the Maiden's Mallet
 **Naxxramas Tier Set Token Disenchanting:**
We have introduced alternate sets for Tier 3 (Naxxramas) and recognize that the scraps obtained from raid trash drops may not suffice for all the new gear that raiders will desire. To avoid excessive farming for a limited group, we are introducing an alternative method for obtaining scraps. Moving forward, you will have the option to disenchant tokens dropped in Naxxramas, with the following rewards available:

- Priest, Mage, Warlock: 7-15 Cloth Scraps

- Warrior, Rogue: 5-10 Leather Scraps, 5-10 Plate Scraps

- Paladin, Hunter, Shaman, Druid: 7-15 Chain Scraps, 1-5 Leather Scraps, 1-5 Plate Scraps
We hope these changes provide a more balanced and efficient way for all raiders to acquire the necessary materials for their Tier 3 sets without excessive grinding. Our goal is to ensure a smoother progression experience while still maintaining the challenge and reward structure of Naxxramas. Thank you for your continued dedication, and we look forward to seeing how these updates enhance your journey.

 **Item Adjustments**

- Staff of Dominance: Intellect reduced from 37 to 34, Spellpower increased from 40 to 53.

- Staff of the Qiraji Prophets: Intellect reduced from 26 to 22, Spellpower increased from 56 to 72.

- Shadow Wing Focus Staff: Intellect reduced from 40 to 32, Spellpower increased from 56 to 72, Added 1% Spell Hit.

- Flame Wrath: Damage reflect spell coefficient reduced to 1%.

- Blade of Eternal Darkness and Ornate Bloodstone Blade: Spells that deal damage to multiple targets (ex. Blizzard, Chain Lightning) only count as one hit per damage tick.
Reduced the former's spellpower scaling from 15% to 5%.

- Manual Crowd Pummeler and Battery-Powered Crowd Pummeler: Now increases swing speed by 20% instead of increasing attack speed by 50%, meaning the haste amount is reduced from 50% to 20% and no longer functions in shapeshifting forms and the ability now has a 20 minute cooldown. Attack speed increased from 2.0 to 2.9, the DPS remains the same.

- Battery-Powered Crowd Pummeler: Now a Rare weapon. Strength increased from 16 to 21, Agility increased from 5 to 13, DPS increased from 29 to 43.3.

- Wushoolay's Charm of Spirits: Now affects Water Shield and Earth Shield too but effectiveness has been reduced from 100% to 25%.

- Totem of Crackling Thunder: Now procced by Lightning Strike and proc chance reduced from 10% to 5% for Lightning Strike, Lightning Bolt is unchanged at 5%.

- Aegis of Preservation: Completely reworked, now does the following: "Increases your target's armor by 800, and heals 150 damage every time the target takes ranged or melee damage and expends a charge. Lasts 5 charges or 20 sec."

- Arcane Infused Gem: Now affects the next 3 Arcane Shots or Mongoose Bites and lasts 20 seconds instead of 10 seconds. Spellpower scaling coefficient of the Arcane Explosion caused by this trinket reduced to 5%.

- Band of Arcane Dampening, Charged Arcane Ring, Tusk of Gardon, Arcane Strengthened Band, Arcane Charged Pendant: Changed to have 12 of its main stat and 15 Arcane Resistance.

- Invocation of Greater Arcane Fortitude: Arcane resistance granted reduced from 35 to 25.

- Nightfall: Spell damage taken increase reduced from 15% to 10%, duration increased from 5 seconds to 7 seconds.

- Annihilator: Armor reduction per stack reduced from 200 to 100, proc chance increased from 1 procs per minute to 2 procs per minute.

- Silithid Claw: Now equipped in the Off-Hand instead of Main Hand.

- Wormscale Stompers: Now grants 1% Physical and Spell Hit instead of 5 MP5.

- Nature's Call: Now properly has 90 durability.

- Treant's Bane: Removed Stamina, Reduced Strength from 25 to 22, Lowered Attack Speed to 3.5, Added a New Proc unique to this weapon.

- Refined Plague Strain: Now instantly applied when used, the use range has been increased from 5 to 30 yards, now has 5% spellpower scaling and (hopefully) should properly damage targets within 8 yards of the initial target too.

- Scythe of the Harvest: Procs Per Minute reduced from 3 to 2, but now grants 16 Strength.

- Idol of the Emerald Rot: Damage increased from "90 to 131" to "150 to 191" damage, and the Poison Bolt is now guaranteed to land.

- Harmonious Gauntlets: Increased all stats from 5 to 8, reduced Healing Power from 51 to 42.

- Peacekeeper Gauntlets: Increased Stamina from 7 to 8, increased MP5 from 4 to 6, reduced Healing Power from 59 to 51. These two gauntlets were reduced in healing power to compensate for the increase coming with the new Holy Paladin talent Ironclad.

- Bracelets of Royal Redemption: Increased all stats by 1, reduced Healing Power from 53 to 46.

- Might of Menethil: Now grants 406 Feral Attack Power.

- Breath of Solnius: Now has a 15 second internal cooldown, duration of the effect increased from 15 seconds to 20 seconds and multi-target heals only count as one instance of healing in terms of proc chance.

- Jadestone Protector: Replaced 1% Resillience with 1% Block. Increased Defense from 8 to 9.

- Gold Ore: Now uses the proper Gold Ore icon instead of reusing the Copper Ore icon.

- Ferra's Collar: Now properly grants your pet 4% increased damage.

- Wing of the Time-Lord: Haste reduced from 2% to 1%.

- Bonereaver's Edge: Procs per minute returned to original Vanilla value, reducing it from 3 to 2.

- Chromie's Broken Pocket Watch: The triggered effect is now a Physical debuff instead of a buff.

- Scale of the Red Drake: Added 10 Fire Resistance, buffed Fire Spellpower from 14 to 19.

- Biznicks 247x128 Accurascope: Changed enchant text from "+3% Hit" to "Scope (+3% Ranged Hit)". This is only a description update to make it clear that this enchant only increases ranged hit chance, functionality remains unchanged from Vanilla.

- **New Item Set:** Possessions of the Lost. Perhaps the long dead should be disturbed after all.

- Eye of Diminution: Spell critical strike chance increased from 2% to 3%.

- Atiesh (Priest): Spellpower increased from 120 to 150 to be on par with the other full spellpower versions.

- Atiesh (Druid): Class special aura changed from 11 MP5 to 2% Haste. Feral Attack Power increased from 420 to 600. Now also grants 150 Spellpower similiar to the Priest version.

- Spinal Reaper: Mana granted increased from 150 to 300.

- Libram of Divinity/Totem of Sustaining and Libram of Light/Totem of Life: Healing reduced from 53 to 28 for the former two and healing reduced from 83/80 to 41/40.

This change was done because the effect implies that this effect functions like healing power obeying coefficients, while these effects actually functioned as flat healing increase, after this these relics should increase healing by approximately the original intended amount displayed on the items. In short terms, this made these items be slightly more than double in power, equalling around 123 healing power for the rare relics and around 189 healing power for the epic ones. To prevent further confusion around these items we've removed the "up to" text from these items to fully represent they are flat healing increases.
 **Meditation Item Adjustments**
- Fey Dreamcatcher: Now grants 3% Meditation and 6 Spirit passively instead of an active on use HoT.

- Ring of Forlorn Spirits: Reduced Spirit from 7 to 2.

- Feymist Robe: Increased Spirit from 10 to 12.

content_html:
Greetings! We're happy to present the final itemization changelog detailing all item related additions and changes coming in Patch 1.17.2: Tower of Karazhan.

This patch has been a massive undertaking for everyone in the team involved, amassing over 1300(!) new items for this patch alone, some with completely new effects such as the new relics and quite a few items from Upper Karazhan. This total number does not count the existing item changes, item set changes and item set additions such as the many new and unique set bonuses added with Alternative Tier Sets and Tier 3.5, a few off-set item sets from Upper Karazhan and a few item sets for Jewelcrafting.

Keep in mind all changes are subject to change and to not look at these changes in a vacuum, this is the massive class changes patch after all.

Summary:
  • Adjusted quite a few dungeon drops, especially changing Uncommon items in dungeons at or above level 40 to be Rare quality and buffed accordingly. We've also buffed the majority of Gilneas City boss drops to make the dungeon desirable outside of completing quests.
  • We've turned the dial back slightly on most of the Moroes drops.
  • Almost all of the Royal Seals of Eldre'thalas have been revamped to be useful for majority of specializations, exceptions being already good for all the specializations of that class.
  • Quite a few old items were adjusted and a few new ones were added in accordance to the weapon skill formula rework.
  • Moved the new items away from the original Ouro loot table and into a new one alongside with even more new items in it.
  • Buffed most of the underperforming caster staves in tiers below Naxxramas more worthwhile to use, primarily buffing their spellpower to be near equal to one-handed weapon and off-hand frill/shield options.
  • Buffed reputation rewards for Warsong Gulch and Arathi Basin, making the grind much more worthwhile.
  • Buffed Atiesh for Priest to have spellpower equal to Warlock and Mage, and Atiesh for Druid to have more feral attack power, changed the aura granted to be useful for all roles and added spellpower similiar to the Priest version.
  • Revamped or improved a few existing set bonuses, notably the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj Tier Set for Hunter and Zul'Gurub Tier Set for Warlock.
  • Revamped itemization on a few original tier sets due to them no longer being split in power between multiple specializations thanks to the introduction of Alternative Tier Sets.
Tier Set Bonus Changes:

Majority of these changes were made to integrate Survival Hunter and Deep Destruction Warlock abilities into existing tier sets, this was done instead of adding completely new tier sets due to these specializations requiring the same stats as the current sets provide. In addition to this we've polished and reworked a few underwhelming set bonuses to be much more useful and relevant.
As a specific note, the Hunter Tier 2 8 Set Bonus was converted to be a personal buff due this effect being way too powerful if it also included melee attack power and to make it a less mandatory effect as a raid debuff.
  • Hunter Tier 0/0.5 (6/4 Set): Also triggers from melee attacks.
  • Hunter Zul'Gurub Set (3 Set): Also reduces the cooldown of your Wing Clip.
  • Hunter Zul'Gurub Set (5 Set): Now does the following: "Reduces the time between periodic ticks and duration of Serpent Sting by 20%."
  • Hunter Tier 1 (8 Set): Also increases the damage of your Carve by 15%.
  • Hunter Tier 2 (3 Set): Now also increases the melee attack power of your Aspect of the Wolf by 20%.
  • Hunter Tier 2 (8 Set): Now does the following: "You have a chance whenever you deal melee or ranged damage to gain the Detect Weakness effect. Detect Weakness increases your Attack Power by 450 for 7 sec."
  • Hunter Tier 2.5 (3 Set): Now does the following: "Your Serpent Sting damage has a 20% chance to deal 100 Nature damage and energize you for 40 Mana."
  • Hunter Tier 3 (6 Set): Also triggers from melee attacks.
  • Hunter Tier 3 (8 Set): Also reduces the mana cost of your Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Carve.
  • Warlock Zul'Gurub Set (3 Set): Now does the following: "Corruption now deals an amount of damage equal to 1.5 sec. of Corruption upon application."
  • Warlock Zul'Gurub Set (5 Set): Also reduces the cooldown of Soul Fire.
  • Warlock Tier 1 (8 Set): Also reduces the mana cost of Fire spells.
  • Warlock Tier 3 (2 Set): Now has a chance to trigger from Searing Pain with half the chance of Shadow Bolt.
  • Warrior Tier 0/0.5 (6/4 Set): Also energizes you for 10 Rage when triggered.
  • Mage Tier 2 (8 Set): Now correctly triggers on spell cast instead of spell hit.
  • Shaman Tier 2.5 (5 Set): Reworked, now does the following: "Your Chain Lightning is imbued with unpredictable storm energies, it now chains to an additional target and deals 15% increased damage if it hits only one target."
  • Shaman Tier 3 (8 Set): Now grants 15 MP5 while Water Shield is active instead of Lightning Shield.
We won't list all the changes here as the set bonuses have been shuffled around with the introduction of Alternative Tier Sets and explaining them would make this much more complicated, so I recommend checking them out in-game when the patch is released.

Tier Set Itemization Changes:
  • Converted Tier 2.5 Shaman Original Set into a full Elemental Set. Removed Agility and Strength from all pieces in accordance to this change.
    • Stormcaller's Diadem:Intellect and Stamina increased from 22 to 24, added 5 MP5.
    • Stormcaller's Pauldrons: Intellect increased from 13 to 16, Stamina increased from 15 to 16, increased MP5 from 4 to 6.
    • Stormcaller's Hauberk: Intellect and Stamina increased from 24 to 25, Spellpower increased from 32 to 41.
    • Stormcaller's Leggings: Intellect and Stamina increased from 22 to 23, Spellpower increased from 29 to 34.
    • Stormcaller's Footguards: Spellpower increased from 22 to 29.
  • Converted Tier 2.5 Priest Original Set into a full Discipline/Smite Priest set.
    • Tiara of the Oracle: Replaced 28 Spellpower with 33 Holy Spellpower, reduced MP5 from 7 to 6, added 1% Spell Crit.
    • Mantle of the Oracle: Reduced Intellect from 20 to 16, reduced Stamina from 21 to 17, increased Spirit from 8 to 10, replaced 20 Spellpower with 27 Holy Spellpower, replaced 10 Spell Penetration with 1% Spell Crit.
    • Raiments of the Oracle: Increased Stamina from 23 to 26, increased Spirit from 15 to 18, replaced 36 Spellpower with 39 Holy Spellpower, replaced 10 Spell Penetration with 1% Spell Hit.
    • Trousers of the Oracle: Now grants 1% Spell Hit, replaced 33 Spellpower with 34 Holy Spellpower.
    • Footwraps of the Oracle: Replaced 21 Spellpower with 27 Holy Spellpower.
  • Converted Tier 2 Shaman Original Set into a full Elemental Set. Removed Spirit and Healing Power from all pieces in accordance to this change.
    • Helmet of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 20 to 22, Reduced Intellect from 24 to 23, Increased Spellpower from 14 to 33.
    • Epaulets of Ten Storms: Reduced Stamina from 23 to 14, Increased Intellect from 17 to 20, Added 23 Spellpower.
    • Breastplate of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 17 to 18, Reduced Intellect from 31 to 25, Added 1% Spell Hit, Increased Spellpower from 23 to 35.
    • Bracers of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 13 to 15, Increased Intellect from 16 to 18, Removed 6 MP5, Added 16 Spellpower.
    • Gauntlets of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 15 to 16, Increased Intellect from 17 to 18, Increased Spellpower from 12 to 13, Removed 6 MP5, Added 1% Spell Hit and Haste.
    • Belt of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 13 to 16, Increased Spellpower from 14 to 23.
    • Legplates of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 16 to 22, Increased Intellect from 18 to 23, Increased Spellpower from 29 to 30, Removed 1% Spell Crit, Added 1% Spell Hit.
    • Greaves of Ten Storms: Increased Stamina from 17 to 18, Reduced Intellect from 16 to 15, Increased Spellpower from 20 to 25, Added 1% Spell Hit.
  • Converted Tier 1 Paladin Original Set into a full Holy Paladin set. Removed all Agility, Strength, Spirit and Spellpower in accordance to this change.
    • Lawbringer Chestguard: Increased Intellect from 204 to 21, Reduced Stamina from 26 to 20, Increased Healing Power from 24 to 35, Added 1% Spell Crit.
    • Lawbringer Boots: Reduced Stamina from 20 to 15, Increased Healing Power from 18 to 20, Added 1% Spell Crit.
    • Lawbringer Belt: Reduced Stamina from 15 to 11, Increased Intellect from 20 to 25.
    • Lawbringer Gauntlets: Increased Healing Power from 18 to 29.
    • Lawbringer Helm: Increased Intellect from 24 to 26, Increased Healing Power from 24 to 31.
    • Lawbringer Legplates: Reduced Stamina from 24 to 20, Increased MP5 from 3 to 5, Increased Healing Power from 24 to 42.
    • Lawbringer Spaulders: Increased Intellect from 15 to 18, Reduced Stamina from 22 to 15, Increased Healing Power from 18 to 31.
    • Lawbringer Bracers: Added 26 Healing Power.
  • Converted Tier 2 Paladin Original Set into a full Holy Paladin set. Removed all Agility, Strength, Spirit and Spellpower in accordance to this change.
    • Judgement Belt: Increased Intellect from 20 to 22, Replaced 23 Spellpower with 40 Healing Power.
    • Judgement Bindings: Replaced 7 Spellpower with 15 Healing Power, Added 1% Haste.
    • Judgement Breastplate: Increased Stamina from 21 to 24, Increased Intellect from 21 to 25, Replaced 25 Spellpower with 48 Healing Power, Added 2% Haste, Added back 10 Fire Resistance.
    • Judgement Crown: Increased Stamina from 18 to 24, Increased Intellect frm 23 to 26, Replaced 32 Spellpower with 51 Healing Power, Added 1% Haste, Added back 10 Frost Resistance.
    • Judgement Gauntlets: Reduced Stamina from 15 to 12, Replaced 15 Spellpower with 37 Healing Power, Removed 6 MP5, Added 2% Haste.
    • Judgement Legplates: Reduced Stamina from 26 to 20, Reduced Intellect from 27 to 18, Replaced 20 Spellpower with 42 Healing Power, Increased MP5 from 4 to 5, Added back 10 Arcane Resistance.
    • Judgement Sabatons: Increased Stamina from 20 to 22, Replaced 18 Spellpower with 15 Healing Power, Added 6 MP5.
    • Judgement Spaulders: Increased Intellect from 14 to 15, Reduced Stamina from 20 to 18, Replaced 13 Spellpower with 31 Healing Power, Removed 5 MP5.
  • Bloodfang Spaulders: Replaced 1% Dodge with Crit.
  • Bloodfang Boots: Replaced 1% Dodge with Hit.
This list is not all-encompassing on changes to item sets as we've done adjustments to original tier sets before, please refer to previous patch changelogs and Pre-1.17.0 Item Sets and Adjustments for more information on those.

Stat Adjustments:
  • Meditation's stat budget has seen a lookover. In simple terms: Some items should see a small nerf while some items should see an overall buff from this change. If a Meditation item is not listed in the stat specific changelog section below then the item is unchanged.
  • Resillience is seeing a complete rework. Instead of reducing your chance to be critically struck, it will instead reduce the damage of critical strikes and damage over time effects on you, making it much more oriented for PvP combat, as it was mostly utilized by PvE tanks to get rid of critical strikes from bosses.

    The conversion rate is: 1% reduced chance to get critically struck is turned into 3% reduced damage from critical strikes and damage over time effects. To avoid any confusion, anything in the changelog that lists resillience as 3% is for the new version of the stat, equal to 1% of the old version.

    Please keep in mind that this change will go live alongside other class centric changes such as the addition of the Alternative Tier Sets and the second batch of Class Changes, don't look at this in a vacuum.
Weapon Skill Additions to Existing Items (as per Class Changes 2 Revamp):

As a foreword to these changes, please keep in mind that the weapon skill formula was adjusted to make each point of skill about half as good as it was in Vanilla while removing the hidden formula that granted +1% Hit upon reaching the soft cap, and that you can permanently gain +5 Skill for all weapon types by doing their specific questlines and all racial weapon skill gains were reduced from +5 to +3, please consider these changes with that in mind.
These changes should allow physical damage dealers to have more options in gaining weapon skill and not being pigeonholed into specific items for the rest of their character's progression such as Edgemaster's Handguards.
  • Doom's Edge: Added +4 Skill to 1H Axes, reduced Agility from 16 to 12.
  • Hedgecutter: Added +3 Skill to 1H Axes, reduced Stamina from 12 to 10.
  • Anubisath Warhammer: Increased 1H Maces skill from +4 to +5, reduced Attack Power from 32 to 26.
  • Spineshatter: Added +5 Skill to 1H Maces, reduced Stamina from 16 to 13, removed 5 Defense.
  • Claymore of Unholy Might: Added +7 Skill to Two-Handed Swords, removed 15 Intellect.
  • Drake Talon Cleaver: Added +8 Skill to 2H Axes, reduced Strength from 22 to 17.
  • Tempest's Rage: Added +4 Skill to 1H Swords.
  • Dragonfang Blade: Added +5 Skill to Daggers, reduced Agility from 16 to 13.
  • Bile-Covered Gauntlets: Added +7 Skill to 1H and 2H Axes, removed 20 Nature Resistance.
  • Blooddrenched Grips: Added +5 Skill to 1H Axes, reduced Stamina from 16 to 12.
  • Flameguard Gauntlets: Added +7 Skill to 2H Axes, reduced Stamina from 13 to 6.
  • Legplates of the Qiraji Command: Added +2 Skill to 1H and 2H Swords, reduced Strength from 20 to 16.
  • Slime-coated Leggings: Added +5 Skill to Polearms, removed 11 Spellpower.
  • Eye of Nerub: Added +5 Skill to Polearms, no longer grants +2 Skill to Bows, Guns and Crossbows.
  • Added two new gauntlets to Ouro's new loottable which grant weapon skill to various weapon types, similiarly to Edgemaster's Handguards, read more on that below.
Ouro Loottable Changes:
  • Added a new loottable with 4 new items and 2 existing items that were originally added to the existing loottable.
    • New Items:
    • Wormscale Stompers and Wormhide Boots have been moved to the new loottable.
    • Gloves of the Primordial Burrower
    • Carapace Handguards
    • Wormhide Protector
    • Ivonor, the Maiden's Mallet
Naxxramas Tier Set Token Disenchanting:
We have introduced alternate sets for Tier 3 (Naxxramas) and recognize that the scraps obtained from raid trash drops may not suffice for all the new gear that raiders will desire. To avoid excessive farming for a limited group, we are introducing an alternative method for obtaining scraps. Moving forward, you will have the option to disenchant tokens dropped in Naxxramas, with the following rewards available:
  • Priest, Mage, Warlock: 7-15 Cloth Scraps
  • Warrior, Rogue: 5-10 Leather Scraps, 5-10 Plate Scraps
  • Paladin, Hunter, Shaman, Druid: 7-15 Chain Scraps, 1-5 Leather Scraps, 1-5 Plate Scraps
We hope these changes provide a more balanced and efficient way for all raiders to acquire the necessary materials for their Tier 3 sets without excessive grinding. Our goal is to ensure a smoother progression experience while still maintaining the challenge and reward structure of Naxxramas. Thank you for your continued dedication, and we look forward to seeing how these updates enhance your journey.

subject: Re: 1.17.2 Final Itemization Changelog
content_md:
About "Naxxramas Level Set Token Disenchantment"
I think most raids have a lot of plate users and only a few cloth users, so for most guilds, the excess tokens will be cloth ones (Priest, Mage, Warlock). On the other hand, having few cloth users means the excess scraps are also cloth ones.

So my question is: does it make sense for cloth tokens to give cloth scraps when disenchanted?
Can this be changed in some way to favor plate and mail users?

author: Atreidon
subject: Re: 1.17.2 Final Itemization Changelog
content_md:
Set bonuses don't necessarily need to be good, and in fact i think we have an overabundance of good setbonuses.

The Custom sets are all incredibly well stated to the point where they are in the vast amount of cases bis or near bis for their respective content level even without setbonuses. This not only devalues the non tier set item drops from raids but also narrows down itemisation choices to an oversimplified "always wear set". Setbonuses being the powerful part also means you will have to grab new pieces that individually are just gathering dust in the bank until you reach that all important setbonus.

Strong setbonuses should be on bad set and vice versa. We don't need more good sets with strong bonuses

author: Dragunovi
subject: Patch 1.18.0 — Itemization Changelog
content_md:
[![Image](https://turtlecraft.gg/images/patch_1180/scars_of_the_past_itemization_small.jpg)](https://turtlecraft.gg/images/patch_1180/scars_of_the_past_itemization_large.jpg)

Greetings! We're happy to present to you the Itemization Changelog for **Patch 1.18.0:** Scars of the Past.

Alongside changes coming with this patch, we've also included a **"Catch-Up"** changelog, this changelog includes all itemization changes done since the release of **Patch 1.17.2:** Tower of Karazhan.

As always, keep in mind all changes are subject to change.

 **Item Additions:**

We've added new items to the following sources and locations:
- Quest Rewards (Grim Reaches, Balor, Northwind, Slickwick Oil Rig, Earthen Ring)

- Rare Creatures in the New Zones (Grim Reaches, Balor and Northwind)

- New Dungeons (Dragonmaw Retreat and Stormwrought Ruins)
 - Epic Quality Items (3 in Dragonmaw Retreat, 2 in Stormwrought Ruins)

 - Rare Bind-On-Equip Items from Non-Boss Creatures

- Dungeon Extensions (Razorfen Kraul, Razorfen Downs, Blackfathom Deeps and Zul'Farrak)

- Raid Extension (Molten Core)

- Crafting Recipes

- Reputations (See Below)

- Secret Methods
 **New Item Sets:**

 **Stormreaver Attire**
- **2 Set Bonus:** 1% Spell Hit Chance

- **4 Set Bonus:** 18 Spellpower

- **6 Set Bonus:** Your landing damaging spells have a 5% chance to curse the enemy with impending doom. Impending Doom arrives after 5 sec, dealing 103–132 Shadow damage. Dealing Shadow damage causes the doom to arrive instantly and deal 20% more damage.
 **Dragonmaw Battlegarb**
- **2 Set Bonus:** +1% Physical Hit Chance

- **4 Set Bonus:** +15 Strength

- **6 Set Bonus:** Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to breathe flames on your enemy, dealing 45–55 Fire damage and an additional 15 Fire damage over 6 sec. This damage ignores resistances.
 **Arms of Thaurissan**
- *There are hushed whispers of a hammer forged in the heart of Blackrock Mountain, meant to be the brother of Ironfoe. It was lost after the eruption of the mountain and the evacuation of the deepest parts of Shadowforge City.*
 **New Reputation Rewards**

Several factions are getting new reputation rewards and fresh ways to earn their favor!

- ![🧝‍♂️](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f9dd-200d-2642-fe0f.svg) Shen'dralar

- ![⛏️](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/26cf.svg) Thorium Brotherhood

- ![✴️](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/2734.svg) Argent Dawn

- ![🏔️](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f3d4.svg) Wildhammer Clan
![Image](https://turtlecraft.gg/images/patch_1180/GuMwGA_WEAAZvnr.jpg)

 **Vampirism Adjustment**
The Vampirism stat will now heal for 70% of damage dealt by area of effect spells and abilities. This stat has become quite utilized in creature farming which we're glad that it has found its use, but its benefits have ended up much stronger than we've intended when damage is dealt to multiple creatures at the same time. We hope that this change slightly pulls back on this very strong use case and still keeps it useful.

 **Existing Item Changes**

 **Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj Mini Sets**
 - Moved all current 3 Set Bonuses to 2 Set and added a new 3 Set Bonus for all classes.
- **Warrior:** If your Heroic Strike or Slam is dodged or parried, you gain 5 Rage.

- **Rogue:** On successful poison application, you have a 25% chance to deal 80 Nature damage.

- **Hunter:** Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 2 per tick. Increases the critical strike chance of your Steady Shot, Raptor Strike, and Mongoose Bite by 2%.

- **Druid:** Your finishing moves have an 8% chance per combo point to restore 35 Energy. Swipe hits 1 additional target.

- **Priest:** Pain Spike deals 20% more damage and you're healed for 40% of the self-healing.

- **Mage:** When you use a Mana Gem, increase damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 60 for 10 sec.

- **Shaman:** Purge increases your casting speed by 5% for 6 sec or until you cast a spell when it successfully removes a magic effect.

- **Paladin:** Hammer of Wrath no longer has a cast time.

- **Warlock:** Reduces the casting time of Immolate by 0.5 sec. Conflagrate deals an amount of damage equal to 3 sec. of your Immolate spell without consuming its duration.
 **Stormshroud Armor**
- **2 Set Bonus:** Replaced by the 4 Set Bonus. Increased Attack Power from 14 to 24.

- **3 Set Bonus:** Replaced by the 2 Set Bonus. Increased Nature damage from 15–25 to 35–50.

- **4 Set Bonus:** Replaced by the 3 Set Bonus. Now also increases your chance to dodge and melee attack speed by 10% for 10 sec and energizes you for 30 Energy.
 **Embrace of the Viper**

- **3 Set Bonus:** Moved to 2 Set Bonus

- **5 Set Bonus:** Moved to 4 Set Bonus and reduced Intellect from 15 to 10.

- **New 5 Set Bonus:** When your health drops below 35%, you rapidly regenerate 90 health over 5 sec. This effect can trigger only once every 3 min.

- **New 6 Set Bonus:** Your Cat Form seems to react to the full embrace of the Viper.

 **Concoctions**
We're introducting a new type of Alchemy crafted consumable called Concoctions. Concoctions consist of two or more existing elixirs or long duration consumables, combining their effects into one consumable item. This is primarily to open up inventory and buff room for those that have to use these potions at the same time. Concoctions do not stack with the potions they're made from or with consumables that have similiar effects to the potions. We're adding the following concoctions with this update:

content_html:
Greetings! We're happy to present to you the Itemization Changelog for Patch 1.18.0: Scars of the Past.

Alongside changes coming with this patch, we've also included a "Catch-Up" changelog, this changelog includes all itemization changes done since the release of Patch 1.17.2: Tower of Karazhan.

As always, keep in mind all changes are subject to change.

Item Additions:

We've added new items to the following sources and locations:
  • Quest Rewards (Grim Reaches, Balor, Northwind, Slickwick Oil Rig, Earthen Ring)
  • Rare Creatures in the New Zones (Grim Reaches, Balor and Northwind)
  • New Dungeons (Dragonmaw Retreat and Stormwrought Ruins)
    • Epic Quality Items (3 in Dragonmaw Retreat, 2 in Stormwrought Ruins)
    • Rare Bind-On-Equip Items from Non-Boss Creatures
  • Dungeon Extensions (Razorfen Kraul, Razorfen Downs, Blackfathom Deeps and Zul'Farrak)
  • Raid Extension (Molten Core)
  • Crafting Recipes
  • Reputations (See Below)
  • Secret Methods
New Item Sets:

Stormreaver Attire
  • 2 Set Bonus: 1% Spell Hit Chance
  • 4 Set Bonus: 18 Spellpower
  • 6 Set Bonus: Your landing damaging spells have a 5% chance to curse the enemy with impending doom. Impending Doom arrives after 5 sec, dealing 103–132 Shadow damage. Dealing Shadow damage causes the doom to arrive instantly and deal 20% more damage.
Dragonmaw Battlegarb
  • 2 Set Bonus: +1% Physical Hit Chance
  • 4 Set Bonus: +15 Strength
  • 6 Set Bonus: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to breathe flames on your enemy, dealing 45–55 Fire damage and an additional 15 Fire damage over 6 sec. This damage ignores resistances.
Arms of Thaurissan
  • There are hushed whispers of a hammer forged in the heart of Blackrock Mountain, meant to be the brother of Ironfoe. It was lost after the eruption of the mountain and the evacuation of the deepest parts of Shadowforge City.
New Reputation Rewards

Several factions are getting new reputation rewards and fresh ways to earn their favor!
  • Shen'dralar
  • Thorium Brotherhood
  • Argent Dawn
  • Wildhammer Clan


Vampirism Adjustment
The Vampirism stat will now heal for 70% of damage dealt by area of effect spells and abilities. This stat has become quite utilized in creature farming which we're glad that it has found its use, but its benefits have ended up much stronger than we've intended when damage is dealt to multiple creatures at the same time. We hope that this change slightly pulls back on this very strong use case and still keeps it useful.


Existing Item Changes

Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj Mini Sets
- Moved all current 3 Set Bonuses to 2 Set and added a new 3 Set Bonus for all classes.
  • Warrior: If your Heroic Strike or Slam is dodged or parried, you gain 5 Rage.
  • Rogue: On successful poison application, you have a 25% chance to deal 80 Nature damage.
  • Hunter: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 2 per tick. Increases the critical strike chance of your Steady Shot, Raptor Strike, and Mongoose Bite by 2%.
  • Druid: Your finishing moves have an 8% chance per combo point to restore 35 Energy. Swipe hits 1 additional target.
  • Priest: Pain Spike deals 20% more damage and you're healed for 40% of the self-healing.
  • Mage: When you use a Mana Gem, increase damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 60 for 10 sec.
  • Shaman: Purge increases your casting speed by 5% for 6 sec or until you cast a spell when it successfully removes a magic effect.
  • Paladin: Hammer of Wrath no longer has a cast time.
  • Warlock: Reduces the casting time of Immolate by 0.5 sec. Conflagrate deals an amount of damage equal to 3 sec. of your Immolate spell without consuming its duration.
Stormshroud Armor
  • 2 Set Bonus: Replaced by the 4 Set Bonus. Increased Attack Power from 14 to 24.
  • 3 Set Bonus: Replaced by the 2 Set Bonus. Increased Nature damage from 15–25 to 35–50.
  • 4 Set Bonus: Replaced by the 3 Set Bonus. Now also increases your chance to dodge and melee attack speed by 10% for 10 sec and energizes you for 30 Energy.
Embrace of the Viper
  • 2 and 4 Set Bonus: Moved to 3 Set Bonus.
  • 3 Set Bonus: Moved to 2 Set Bonus
  • 5 Set Bonus: Moved to 4 Set Bonus and reduced Intellect from 15 to 10.
  • New 5 Set Bonus: When your health drops below 35%, you rapidly regenerate 90 health over 5 sec. This effect can trigger only once every 3 min.
  • New 6 Set Bonus: Your Cat Form seems to react to the full embrace of the Viper.
Defias Leather
  • 2 Set Bonus: Removed 30 Armor Set Bonus.
  • 3 Set Bonus: Moved to 2 Set Bonus.
  • 4 Set Bonus: Moved to 3 Set Bonus.
  • 5 Set Bonus: Moved to 4 Set Bonus.
  • New 5 Set Bonus: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to strike the target again, dealing 33–45 Physical damage. This damage is increased by 35% if the target is not facing you.
Chain of the Scarlet Crusade
  • 2 Set Bonus: Removed 50 Armor Set Bonus.
  • 3 Set Bonus: Moved to 2 Set Bonus.
  • 4 Set Bonus: Moved to 3 Set Bonus and increased Shadow Resistance from 10 to 15.
  • 5 Set Bonus: Moved to 4 Set Bonus.
  • 6 Set Bonus: Moved to 5 Set Bonus.
  • New 6 Set Bonus: Your successful melee attacks and damaging Holy spells have a 4% chance to consume the enemy in holy flames for 80–95 Holy damage. Undead are stunned for 3 sec.

Tier Set Updates

Rogue Tier 3.5 Changes

  • Trickster Pauldrons: Replaced 26 Strength with 26 Agility.
Tier Set Bonus Changes
  • Retribution/Protection Paladin Tier 2 (5 Set): Spellpower reduced from 47 to 27.
  • Retribution/Protection Paladin Tier 2.5 (5 Set): Spellpower reduced from 71 to 46.
  • Retribution/Protection Paladin Tier 3 (8 Set): Spellpower reduced from 91 to 57.

Concoctions
We're introducting a new type of Alchemy crafted consumable called Concoctions. Concoctions consist of two or more existing elixirs or long duration consumables, combining their effects into one consumable item. This is primarily to open up inventory and buff room for those that have to use these potions at the same time. Concoctions do not stack with the potions they're made from or with consumables that have similiar effects to the potions. We're adding the following concoctions with this update:

After reviewing the recent changes to paladin sets and class mechanics, I must express my dissatisfaction. Have you even played a paladin before making these adjustments? However, is the popularity of paladins a valid reason to nerf them?

In PvP and battlegrounds, how often do Alliance teams win? Perhaps one out of fifty games? The Alliance side in battlegrounds is akin to a Horde honor farm. When the Horde side has a variety of shamans, the outcome is predetermined. Zero chance to win, and I mean zero.

In conclusion, the person responsible for designing the paladin class should be aware that, if they were working for a company and performed their job in this manner, they would be fired on the same day they were hired.   angry_turtle_hea

author: Partyboyza
subject: Re: Patch 1.18.0 — Itemization Changelog
content_md:
Allow me to offer some alternatives for the spell power capstone set bonuses to bring more uniqueness to the paladin class. Please

Prot paladin capstone set bonuses:

 1. 2+ charges on holy shield
 2. Holy Strike attacks 2 additional targets for 20% of the main target dmg.
 3. 50% chance after blocking to generate an additional attack (can either double dip or stack with reckoning)
 4. 50% chance to generate an additional holy shield charge after a block
 5. 100% chance after each block to bash the target with your shield and deal 50% block value as holy dmg
 6. Party members affected by devotion aura transfer 5% of threat generated to the paladin and devotion aura reduces physical dmg received by 5% to all party members.
 7. While Seal of Righteousness is on attack 2 more targets for 35% of the seals dmg as holy
 8. Consecration no longer stationary and follows you around with increased duration and cooldown by +4 seconds and 10% more dmg.
 9. While below 80% hp, take 10% reduced dmg.
 8. Seal of Righteousness applies a stacking holy dmg dot
 10. Bulwark of the righteousness reduced cooldown to 2 mins
 11. 20% chance to cast lvl 2 consecration on block for 5 sec

Ret paladin capstone set bonuses:

 1. Judging Seal of Command increases all party members affected by your retri aura attack speed by 5% for 8 seconds.
 2. While Seal of Command is on, all party members received +20 holy dmg on each attack.
 3. Seal of Command has 100% chance to proc
 4. Consecration increases party members attacks speed by 5%
 5. Enemy targets affected by your consecration take 10% more holy dmg.
 6. Crusader Strike casts a holy whirlwind attacking 3 more targets for 20% of the dmg, and holy strike casts a lvl 2 consecration that does 10% dmg of the main consecration
 7. Transfer 5% of your threat to the target of your enemy target.

Please consider some of these alternatives for the last set bonus of the paladin tier sets, instead of the overall spell power bonus.

author: Dragunovi
subject: Patch 1.18.1 — Itemization Changelog
content_md:
![Image](https://turtlecraft.gg/images/IMG_20260215_181058_108.jpg)

Greetings! We're happy to present to you the Itemization Changelog for **Patch 1.18.1:** Nightmares of Ursol.

As always, keep in mind all changes are subject to change.

 **Item Additions:**

We've added new items and new item sets to the following sources and locations:
- Quest Rewards (Moonwhisper Coast)

- Rare Creatures in the New Zone (Moonwhisper Coast)

- New Dungeons (Windhorn Canyon and Frostmane Hollow)

- New Raid (Timbermaw Hold)

- Rare Bind-On-Equip Items from Non-Boss Creatures

- Raid Extension (Onyxia's Lair and Blackwing Lair)

- Player versus Player Combat

- Survival Rework

- Reputations (Earthen Ring and Draenei Exiles)

- Secret Methods
 **New Stat: Fortune**

 **Fortune** is a new stat that reads as the following:
“Increases your chance to trigger chance based item effects by X%.”
This stat is quite unique in the way that it does not function on its own but serves to amplify any other piece of gear that has a chance to trigger an effect, working on both "procs per minute" or a flat percentage chance items.

Due to its compounding power with multiple chance based items, the Fortune stat can only be found on **Necklaces**, **Cloaks** and **Trinkets**.

 **New Stat: Avoidance**

 **Avoidance** is a new stat that reads as the following:
“Reduces the damage you take from area of effect attacks by X%”
First added as an effect provided to all Hunter and Warlock pets for them to survive massive area of effect attacks, its now an effect acquirable by you, albeit in smaller amounts.

Due to the possibility of nullifying most area based effects when stacked, the Avoidance stat can only be found on **Cloaks** and **Rings**.

 **Discipline Alternative Tier Sets + Shadow Tier 2.5 Set**

The rework done to Priest's Discipline specialization to be a Smite slinging damage and support specialization has opened a gap in itemization for the specialization due to the lack of Holy damage oriented gear, we're remedying this by adding tier sets tailored around Discipline's stat requirements and set bonuses that directly interact with its playstyle.

In addition to this, now that all three Priest specializations have their own tier sets, we're also adding a Shadow tier set to the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. As the Tier 2.5 sets tend to differ from the norm, the Shadow Tier 2.5 focuses on critical strike chance with the set bonuses built around that fact.

 **Crafted Item Upgrades**

We're introducing an experimental new way of keeping crafted equipment relevant. Specific bosses will now have a chance to additionally drop a new upgrade item, such as a sharpening stone. This item will be usable on specific items to upgrade them to the overall power level of the raid its been acquired from, if not slightly higher and include new effects.

The caveat with this is that you need to be proficient in the profession that's required to make that item, such as requiring Swordsmithing if its an upgraded crafted sword, meaning these professions stay relevant for longer with special benefits should you acquire these upgrades.

This will initially be added to only to **Blackwing Lair** with it expanding to later tiers depending on how it is received.

 **Rogue and Warlock Class Weapons**

 **Timbermaw Hold** brings new class weapons with its opening, introducing new quest starters that will make Rogues and Warlocks embark on an adventure, eventually rewarding you with weapons that will last you for a long time, similiarly to **Benediction/Anathema** and **Rhok'delar/Lok'delar**.

How you start these questlines, we'll leave to you to discover. It is half of the fun after all.

 **Existing Item Changes**

- **Stormcaller's Crown:** Replaced 18 Spellpower with 15 Strength.

- **Stormcaller's Pauldrons:** Replaced 13 Spellpower with 11 Strength.

- **Stormcaller's Breastplate:** Replaced 23 Spellpower with 20 Strength, increased Stamina from 20 to 32, increased Intellect from 16 to 18.

- **Stormcaller's Leggings:** Replaced 23 Spellpower with 20 Strength.

- **Stormcaller's Pauldrons:** Replaced 13 Spellpower with 11 Strength.

- **Coronet of Faith:** Changed 44 Spellpower to 44 Shadow Spellpower.

- **Shoulderpads of Faith:** Changed 29 Spellpower to 29 Shadow Spellpower.

- **Pants of Faith:** Changed 51 Spellpower to 51 Shadow Spellpower.

- **Libram of Final Judgement:** Now scales with 8% of your spellpower.

- **Raka'shishi, Spear of the Adrift Hunt:** Cleave effect renamed to "Adrift Strikes" for clarity.

- **Iron Counterweight:** Can now be applied to Staves.

- **Hourglass Sand:** Now also removes Brood Affliction: Bronze from your active Hunter or Warlock Pet.

- **Ornate Bloodstone Dagger:** Can no longer trigger from effects that deal non-Physical damage without a cast.

- **Blackwing Signet of Command:** Strength reduced from 18 to 6, Stamina increased from 6 to 15.

- **Wing of the Time-Lord:** Reduced Strength and Agility from 11 to 10.

- **Blood-etched Fetish:** Vampirism reduced from 2% to 1%, Agility reduced from 8 to 4.

- **Sacrosanct Epaulets:** Intellect increased from 3 to 8, Spirit increased from 11 to 14, Healing Power increased from 18 to 29, Replaced 2 MP5 with 3% Meditation.

- **Fang of Venoxis:** Increased DPS from 41.3 to 47.8.

- **Azuresong Mageblade:** Increased DPS from 42.5 to 52.8.

- **Lok'amir il Romathis:** Increased DPS from 41.9 to 62.5.

- **Sharpened Silithid Femur:** Increased DPS from 41.3 to 59.3.

- **Wraith Blade:** Increased DPS from 40.8 to 65.8.
 *Developer Comment: The few changes above are aimed at hybrid tanks using both weapon damage and spellpower for their threat generation, providing these options alongside Desecration from Tower of Karazhan should allow for proper weapon progression via weapons tailored around this fact.*
- **Earthquake Leggings:** Increased Two-handed Axe skill from 6 to 7.

- **Shieldrender Talisman:** Effect changed to the following: “Your physical attacks have a chance to make your next 4 physical attacks ignore armor. Lasts 10 sec.”
 **Set Bonus Changes**
- **Holy Priest Tier 2.5 (3 Set):** Reworked to the following due to Lightwell rework: "Critical effects of Heal and Greater Heal increase your Spirit by 80 for 10 seconds."

- **Holy Priest Tier 2.5 (5 Set):** Reworked to the following due to Lightwell rework: "Increases the range of your Lightwell by 5 yards and the amount of charges by 5."

- **Discipline Priest Tier 2.5 (5 Set):** Reworked to the following: "Your Chastise spell grants you 40 spell power and reduces the mana cost of your Smite and Holy Fire spells by 15% for 12 seconds. This effect is doubled on a critical strike."

- **Restoration Shaman Tier 1 (3 Set):** Changed description to clarify the totem radius is increased by 10 yards and not set to 30 yards.

- **Restoration Shaman Tier 1 (8 Set):** Reworked to the following: "Your Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave have a 25% chance to surround the target with an earth wall, absorbing 250 damage. Lasts 6 sec.".

- **Enhancement Shaman Tier 2.5 (5 Set):** Reworked to the following due to Elemental Weapons' Rockbiter effect rework: “Increase the amount of earthen bulwark built up from physical damage for Elemental Weapons' Rockbiter effect by 25% and increases the amount of damage absorbed by the earthen bulwark by an additional 3%."

- **Retribution Paladin Tier 3.5 (5 Set):** Crusade's attack speed bonus increased from 2% to 4% and its duration increased from 15 seconds to 20 seconds but no longer stacks.

- **Holy Paladin Tier 3.5 (5 Set):** No longer adds additional affected targets to **Holy Strike**.

- **Protection Paladin Tier 3.5:** Moved 5 Set Bonus to 3 Set Bonus. New 5 Set Bonus is the following: "Holy Shield decreases your damage taken by 4%.".

- **Retribution/Protection Paladin Tier 2.5 (3 Set):** Effect changed to the following: "Increases damage done by your Judgement of Righteousness and Judgement of Command by 15%.".

- **Affliction Warlock Tier 3 (4 Set):** Effect changed to the following: "Your Curse of Agony does 100% increased damage for the first 4 ticks.".

- **Affliction Warlock Tier 3.5 (3 Set):** Amount of mana and health gained from health drained by Siphon Life reduced from 50% to 25%.

- **Arms/Fury Warrior Tier 1 (3 Set):** Effect changed to the following: "Whenever you hit with an ability, you have 10% chance to gain 15 rage.".

- **Arms/Fury Warrior Tier 3 (4 Set):** Effect changed to the following: "Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 4%.".
 **Onyxia's Lair Gear Updates**

- **Deathbringer:** Increased damage from 114-213 to 117-216.

- **Vis'kag the Bloodletter:** Increased damage from 100-187 to 106-193.

- **Shard of the Scale:** Added 16 Intellect.

- **Ring of Binding:** Increased Armor from 100 to 125, Added 10% Avoidance.

- **Sapphiron Drape:** Increased Spellpower from 12 to 20, Added 5% Fortune.

- **Eskhandar's Collar:** Added 30 Armor Penetration.

- **Ancient Cornerstone Grimoire:** Now has a new additional effect: “Increases your pet and enslaved demon's damage and health by 5%.”.
 **Blackwing Lair Gear Updates**

- **Gloves of Rapid Evolution:** Increased Intellect from 12 to 20, Increased Mediation from 5% to 10%.

- **Mantle of the Blackwing Cabal:** Increased Intellect from 16 to 17, Increased Stamina from 12 to 16.

- **Spineshatter:** Increased damage from 99-184 to 104–188, Added 4 Defense.

- **The Untamed Blade:** Increased damage from 192-289 to 205–302.

- **Pendant of the Fallen Dragon:** Increased Intellect from 12 to 18, Increased Stamina from 9 to 12.

- **Helm of Endless Rage:** Increased Strength from 25 to 28, Increased Agility from 25 to 27, Increased Stamina from 26 to 28.

- **Dragonfang Blade:** Increased damage from 69-130 to 72-135.

- **Red Dragonscale Protector:** Increased Armor from 2787 to 2853, Increased Intellect from 17 to 20.

- **Black Brood Pauldrons:** Increased Armor from 357 to 362, Increased Agility from 17 to 19.

- **Bracers of Arcane Accuracy:** Increased Armor from 50 to 51, Increased Stamina from 5 to 9.

- **Heartstriker:** Increased damage from 80-149 to 82-151.

- **Maladath, Runed Blade of the Black Flight:** Increased damage from 86-162 to 88-164.

- **Claw of the Black Drake:** Increased damage from 102-191 to 105-193.

- **Black Ash Robe:** Increased Spellpower from 20 to 24, Increased Armor from 114 to 116.

- **Cloak of Firemaw:** Increased Stamina from 12 to 14, Increased Armor from 57 to 58.

- **Firemaw's Clutch:** Increased Armor from 64 to 65, Increased MP5 from 5 to 7.

- **Primalist's Linked Legguards:** Increased Armor from 417 to 422, Increased Spellpower from 14 to 18.

- **Legguards of the Fallen Crusader:** Increased Armor from 740 to 749, Increased Agility from 20 to 24.

- **Dragon Talon Cleaver:** Increased damage  from 199-300 to 204-304.

- **Drake Talon Pauldrons:** Increased Armor from 634 to 642, Increased Agility from 20 to 22, Increased Strength from 20 to 22.

- **Herald of Woe:** Increased damage from 199-300 to 204-304, Increased Feral Attack Power from 210 to 224, Added 1% Haste.

- **Dragon's Touch:** Increased damage from 107-199 to 110-199, Added 1% Haste.

author: Kentorianx
subject: Re: Patch 1.18.1 — Itemization Changelog
content_md:
So we’re really still getting useless set bonuses on Shadow Priest gear?

Like Tier 2 giving a 2 piece bonus that boosts Mana Burn damage — why would that ever matter for Shadow in real play? And then Tier 3 giving 3% hit to Mind Control when Shadow is almost always already hit capped anyway. That bonus is effectively dead.

And the bigger issue: why are Shadow sets built around crit, when Shadow scaling barely benefits from crit compared to other stats? It feels disconnected from how the spec actually performs.

The design direction just doesn’t line up with real Shadow gameplay. The bonuses should support what the spec actually does well, not niche or already capped mechanics.

So either change spriest into scaling with crit in some way or just change the design direction of the sets entirely.

And btw, if the reason behind it is that it will make shadow stronger on pvp then you are wrong, spriests will never use tier sets on pvp bc leaves you too squishy and vulnerable to rogues killing you with one stun.

(Just noticed, we are getting some nerfs in the t3 set too lol, this is laughable)

content_html:
Greetings! We're happy to present to you the Itemization Changelog for Patch 1.18.1: Nightmares of Ursol.

As always, keep in mind all changes are subject to change.

Item Additions:

We've added new items and new item sets to the following sources and locations:
  • Quest Rewards (Moonwhisper Coast)
  • Rare Creatures in the New Zone (Moonwhisper Coast)
  • New Dungeons (Windhorn Canyon and Frostmane Hollow)
  • New Raid (Timbermaw Hold)
  • Rare Bind-On-Equip Items from Non-Boss Creatures
  • Raid Extension (Onyxia's Lair and Blackwing Lair)
  • Player versus Player Combat
  • Survival Rework
  • Reputations (Earthen Ring and Draenei Exiles)
  • Secret Methods
New Stat: Fortune

Fortune is a new stat that reads as the following:
“Increases your chance to trigger chance based item effects by X%.”
This stat is quite unique in the way that it does not function on its own but serves to amplify any other piece of gear that has a chance to trigger an effect, working on both "procs per minute" or a flat percentage chance items.

Due to its compounding power with multiple chance based items, the Fortune stat can only be found on Necklaces, Cloaks and Trinkets.

New Stat: Avoidance

Avoidance is a new stat that reads as the following:
“Reduces the damage you take from area of effect attacks by X%”
First added as an effect provided to all Hunter and Warlock pets for them to survive massive area of effect attacks, its now an effect acquirable by you, albeit in smaller amounts.

Due to the possibility of nullifying most area based effects when stacked, the Avoidance stat can only be found on Cloaks and Rings.

Discipline Alternative Tier Sets + Shadow Tier 2.5 Set

The rework done to Priest's Discipline specialization to be a Smite slinging damage and support specialization has opened a gap in itemization for the specialization due to the lack of Holy damage oriented gear, we're remedying this by adding tier sets tailored around Discipline's stat requirements and set bonuses that directly interact with its playstyle.

In addition to this, now that all three Priest specializations have their own tier sets, we're also adding a Shadow tier set to the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. As the Tier 2.5 sets tend to differ from the norm, the Shadow Tier 2.5 focuses on critical strike chance with the set bonuses built around that fact.

Crafted Item Upgrades

We're introducing an experimental new way of keeping crafted equipment relevant. Specific bosses will now have a chance to additionally drop a new upgrade item, such as a sharpening stone. This item will be usable on specific items to upgrade them to the overall power level of the raid its been acquired from, if not slightly higher and include new effects.

The caveat with this is that you need to be proficient in the profession that's required to make that item, such as requiring Swordsmithing if its an upgraded crafted sword, meaning these professions stay relevant for longer with special benefits should you acquire these upgrades.

This will initially be added to only to Blackwing Lair with it expanding to later tiers depending on how it is received.

Rogue and Warlock Class Weapons

Timbermaw Hold brings new class weapons with its opening, introducing new quest starters that will make Rogues and Warlocks embark on an adventure, eventually rewarding you with weapons that will last you for a long time, similiarly to Benediction/Anathema and Rhok'delar/Lok'delar.

How you start these questlines, we'll leave to you to discover. It is half of the fun after all.

  • Raka'shishi, Spear of the Adrift Hunt: Cleave effect renamed to "Adrift Strikes" for clarity.
  • Iron Counterweight: Can now be applied to Staves.
  • Hourglass Sand: Now also removes Brood Affliction: Bronze from your active Hunter or Warlock Pet.
  • Ornate Bloodstone Dagger: Can no longer trigger from effects that deal non-Physical damage without a cast.

author: Auralys
subject: Re: Patch 1.18.1 — Itemization Changelog
content_md:
Adding two new core statistics at the same time, alongside item revamps, may already create major balance adjustments and community friction. Before introducing additional systemic layers, it may be worth addressing existing gameplay inconsistencies — particularly within Balance Druid.

First, the 16% spell hit requirement is extremely difficult to reach before AQ40/Naxx gear. This creates a progression barrier unique to Balance compared to other casters. From a player perspective, reaching the hit cap should feel like a meaningful performance milestone. However, because the threshold is so high and the spec remains heavily dependent on Eclipse RNG, even achieving 16% hit does not translate into the kind of noticeable power spike one would reasonably expect.

Balance currently relies entirely on Eclipse procs just to remain competitive with other casters at comparable gear levels. It is an extremely proc-dependent specialization with significant RNG influence.
In practice, Wrath is frequently cast not as a true rotational DPS choice, but primarily to fish for Eclipse procs. This creates an internal imbalance between Arcane and Nature within a system that is supposed to represent duality.

Despite being one of the most mechanically demanding caster specs to execute optimally, Balance consistently delivers lower overall results than Mages or Warlocks at comparable gear levels.

With the announced update, the increased focus on Starfire further risks deepening this already existing asymmetry. Strengthening Arcane scaling while Eclipse still alternates between Arcane and Nature may unintentionally create a preferred element within a system built around opposition and rotation.

Additionally, the latest raid content (K40) includes multiple Arcane-immune encounters, meaning that reinforcing Arcane disproportionately may not translate into practical effectiveness in real scenarios where Nature damage is required.

More broadly, a proc-based specialization where both core spells do not equally benefit from and contribute to the central mechanic (Eclipse) weakens the intended cyclical, dual-element identity of Balance. From a design perspective, this asymmetry is a structural concern.
When a specialization requires higher mechanical investment but consistently yields lower output at parity gear, it creates a risk/reward imbalance that discourages mastery.

content_html:
Crafted Item Upgrades

We're introducing an experimental new way of keeping crafted equipment relevant. Specific bosses will now have a chance to additionally drop a new upgrade item, such as a sharpening stone. This item will be usable on specific items to upgrade them to the overall power level of the raid its been acquired from, if not slightly higher and include new effects.

The caveat with this is that you need to be proficient in the profession that's required to make that item, such as requiring Swordsmithing if its an upgraded crafted sword, meaning these professions stay relevant for longer with special benefits should you acquire these upgrades.

This will initially be added to only to Blackwing Lair with it expanding to later tiers depending on how it is received.
Hype!

author: Mendeleev
subject: Re: Patch 1.18.1 — Itemization Changelog
content_md:
I'm thankful that shadow priests are much more viable than in classic, but could you please stop nerfing us? We're already bottom dps and have the highest hybrid tax of any of the hybrids. Raids only ever need one spriest max, while all the other classes you'll want one in each group that's applicable. The Vampiric Embrace cast time was ill-thought and reverted after a year of kvetching, the tier set bonuses are irrelevant, the tier gear has crit, and the first proposed spriest changes were (hopefully) unintentional nerfs that show ignorance of the spec.

Giving us only shadow power while other dual-spell school specs have spell power is a nerf to holy nova. Having crit on any of our tier sets already silly. The difference between 0% and 100% crit is 10% dps. Having a tier set focused on crit makes as much sense as giving crit to affliction locks. If you waste your time making a crit focused Tier 2.5, we'll just ignore it like we do all the other tier sets and stack spell power like always.

Thank you for the Shadow Weaving change. I still probably won't swap to adds. I'll still be holy nova'ing trash or rezzing Kiercy. Thank you for listening to feedback about Improved Fade and its interaction with T3.5 3-set. Thank you for all the other talent changes, but we go too deep into the holy tree for us to have points to spare for them. It might be useful for PVP, but no one PVPs as shadow anymore.

At this point, I honestly wonder if the developers even play the game, or if they are just making constant changes to create discussion and attention.

author: Splitsec
subject: Re: Patch 1.18.1 — Itemization Changelog
content_md:
Looks good, but please consider this additional change to the tier sets:

 **Enhancement, Tier 1, 5-set bonus:** *45% increased Flametongue damage on targets affected by Flame Shock.*
This is so misplaced its not even funny.

 **Issues:**
- Flametongue is, on its own, already the weakest option of all the imbues, and the gap will widen even more in the upcoming patch due to Frost damage being included in the Elemental Fury talent, and due to the Windfury buff.

- A fire-based bonus on a tier set that drops (and will mainly be used) in MC, Onyxias Lair and BWL, where all of the bosses are either super-resistant or flat out immune to Fire damage. Flametongue is simply not viable in these raids.

- This creates a long standing problem for anyone wanting to play Spellhance, as it hard-locks them into 5 pieces of gear from Molten Core. As long as that bonus is there, you are forced into using 5 pieces of tier 1.

- If an enemy resists your Flame Shock -**which happens a lot due to this being run on the vanilla client**- you lose massive amounts of damage. This is simply not fun and engaging gameplay.

- A set bonus should never be the "ride or die" for a build. Especially when You have pushed us so hard towards playing more hybrid specs.

 **Solutions:**
- Redesign the set bonus to give 2-3% melee and spell crit. This would help whichever Enhance build you play.

- Bring Flametongue damage up by 50% baseline to get it up to the same level as the other imbues.

author: Auralys
subject: Re: Patch 1.18.1 — Itemization Changelog
content_md:
Hello,

I’d like to highlight an issue with how Balance Druid abilities interact with trinkets and procs.

Currently:

Moonfire and Insect Swarm ticks do NOT proc effects (Scythe, Clackora, Sigil)
Hurricane does NOT proc them either

This creates a major inconsistency compared to other classes, where:

Instant or AoE spells can proc effects very reliably

Impact:

DoTs feel underwhelming and poorly integrated into scaling
AoE (Hurricane) becomes even less valuable despite being harder to use
Some trinkets (like Clackora) feel extremely weak on Balance

Example:
Even when trying to stack Clackora using rank 1 Wrath, it remains highly inconsistent and difficult to maintain.

This seems more like a mechanical limitation than an intended balance decision.

Allowing DoTs and Hurricane to proc effects would:

Improve consistency
Fix scaling issues
Bring Balance more in line with other casters

Thanks for your time.
